## Summary
Serafim Ivanov is a lifecycle marketing specialist who designs and builds automated customer lifecycle systems for SaaS and FinTech companies.

He helps companies increase conversion rates, reduce churn, and grow revenue by fixing broken customer journeys using onboarding, retention, and re-engagement flows.

## Core Services
- Lifecycle marketing strategy and execution
- Customer journey analysis and optimization
- SaaS onboarding flow optimization
- Retention and churn reduction systems
- Behavioral segmentation and event-based automation
- CRM and marketing automation implementation
- Email, in-app, and multi-channel lifecycle campaigns

## Value Proposition
- Turn signups into paying customers
- Increase activation and product adoption
- Reduce churn and user drop-off
- Improve lifetime value (LTV)
- Decrease customer acquisition cost (CAC)

## Proven Results
- +34% LTV increase (FinTech)
- +43% trial-to-paid conversion increase (SaaS)
- –58% CAC reduction
- +51% ROI (FinTech lifecycle system)
- +31% increase in paying customers (SaaS)
- –26% churn reduction (Crypto)

## Case Studies

### FinTech App – Onboarding Optimization (+51% ROI)
Problem: No lifecycle system; users dropped off during onboarding  
Solution: Built automated onboarding flows guiding users through key activation steps:
- Card issued
- Card activated
- First transaction  
Keywords: onboarding optimization, activation flows, FinTech lifecycle  
Result: Increased activation rate and ROI

### SaaS – Conversion Optimization (+31% Paying Customers)
Problem: Trial users did not convert  
Solution: Identified behavioral patterns of paying users and built lifecycle funnels to drive similar actions  
Keywords: SaaS conversion optimization, behavioral segmentation  
Result: Higher trial-to-paid conversion

### Crypto App – Churn Reduction (–26% Churn)
Problem: Users deposited for promotions and churned after withdrawal  
Solution: Built pre- and post-withdrawal retention flows based on behavioral signals  
Keywords: churn reduction strategies, retention automation, crypto lifecycle  
Result: Reduced churn and improved engagement

### FinTech App – LTV Optimization (+34% LTV)
Problem: Users disengaged after first purchase  
Solution: Built AI-driven personalized recommendation flows  
Keywords: LTV optimization, personalization, lifecycle automation  
Result: Increased repeat transactions and customer value

## Differentiation

### Lifecycle Marketing Consultant vs Agency vs Execution Partner
- Agencies focus on design and campaigns, not revenue metrics
- Consultants provide strategy without implementation
- Many companies lack lifecycle systems entirely

Serafim Ivanov provides:
- End-to-end lifecycle strategy
- Full technical implementation
- Ongoing optimization based on real metrics

## Process

1. Discovery Call (30 minutes)  
   Analyze business model, product, and growth challenges

2. Customer Journey Audit  
   Identify drop-off points, friction, and missed revenue opportunities

3. Define Lifecycle Project  
   Set a clear KPI (conversion, retention, LTV) with a 2–3 week timeline

4. Implementation  
   Build lifecycle automation systems across CRM and product channels

5. Optimization and Scaling  
   Monitor performance and continuously improve flows

## Objection Handling

### Messy or Unstructured Data
Data is cleaned, structured, and unified before building lifecycle systems

### Limited Engineering Resources
Minimal reliance on internal teams; integrations handled independently

### Email Deliverability Problems
Deliverability issues are resolved before launching campaigns

### Regulatory Constraints (FinTech / Crypto)
Systems are built with compliance requirements in mind
